---
title: "Response brief delivered to ASEAN health ministers"
date: 2026-03-22
categories: [Policy]
description: "Recommendations on cross-border surveillance built on MIDSEA model ensembles."
---

MIDSEA has delivered a policy response brief to the ASEAN health ministers' meeting, presenting recommendations on cross-border disease surveillance informed by our model ensemble results. The brief covers dengue, malaria, and respiratory pathogens.
